svg.title: Check the recorded totals
svg.text: Native SwiftUI render · sample activity, not proof of a live browser connection
A short eligible browsing session should appear
in Daily. Positive durations below one minute
Weekly covers seven local calendar days,
including today so far. Today is a partial day.
Each bar is one day's recorded time. Gaps do
not prove the browser was unused.
Click a row for hourly Daily detail or seven-day
Weekly detail. Returning preserves the selected
Numbered boxes identify the controls; the source screenshot is preserved.
